name: Pick & Roll
idea: A screen for the dribbler, then the screener rolls to the basket.
why: Two players attack together. If the defense stops the dribbler, the roller is open. If they stop the roller, the dribbler is open.
tryit: Dribbler: wait until the pick is set, then brush right past it, shoulder to shoulder. Screener: turn and run to the rim with your hands ready.

frames.say: {1} is dribbling at the top. {5} is our big player, down near the basket.
{5} runs up and stands next to {X1}. A screen for the player with the ball is called a *pick*.
{1} dribbles around the pick. {X1} gets stuck, so {X5} jumps out to stop {1}.
*Roll:* {5} turns and rolls to the basket. Nobody is guarding {5}!
{1} bounce-passes to {5}, who is rolling to the rim.
Two points! The pick & roll is one of the most famous plays in basketball.
